musee.name: Le grand hall du musée · The museum's great hall
musee.alt: The great hall of the village museum, seen from the near left and slightly above: cream stone columns, a polished pale marble floor, a glass pyramid skylight, a grand staircase rising to an upper gallery balcony and a draped white statue wearing a tiny visitor badge. Up on the balcony a young woman in a yellow dress waves a red scarf over the balustrade, and beside her a photographer in a green cardigan looks through a big old wooden bellows camera. On the left a tour guide in sunglasses and a blue blazer holds up a folded umbrella for his group, a white-haired granny points to her cabinet of colourful seashells, and a young cleaner in blue overalls vacuums the floor in front of a huge gilt-framed landscape masterpiece. In the middle an artist in a flowered smock stands at her easel holding a steaming cup of tea, and in front Monsieur Verbe in a red beret sits on a bench turning a big wooden hourglass, passing the time. On the right a jolly man dressed as a pirate raises his fist in delight at a framed painting, a grey cat sits beside a glass case holding a little model of the museum while a guard smiles at it, and a man in a tweed waistcoat puffs past carrying a tall white obelisk. A yellow door with a crayon on the left wall leads to the art workshop, a dark green door at the back leads to the detective gallery, and a white door with a microscope sign on the right wall leads to the medicine gallery.

atelier.name: L'atelier des enfants · The children's workshop
atelier.alt: The museum's children's workshop on Saturday art club, seen from the near left: sunflower-yellow walls hung with children's paintings, paper ceiling lamps, low wooden tables with paint pots and crayons, a green play mat and a giant crayon used as a coat stand. At the back left a lady illustrator in glasses holds open a huge picture book with a blue whale, a girl with a black bob spins a round zoetrope drum with little galloping horses, and in the teddy hospital corner a girl tends a poorly doll tucked into a toy bed with a thermometer and a hot-water bottle. In front a little girl in a toy nurse's apron sticks a plaster on her teddy bear, and a red-pigtailed girl holds up two batteries beside her stopped toy robot with its battery hatch open. On the right a boy holds up his crayon drawing of a sunny beach, another dips a fat paintbrush into a frying pan of blue paint, a boy kneeling on the mat plays with a big white foam die, and two boys carry a smiling rag doll with a bandaged knee and an arm sling on a little toy stretcher. A slate-blue door on the left leads back to the great hall.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

enquete.name: Les romans policiers · Detective stories
enquete.alt: The museum's detective-story gallery on its 'solve the mystery' family day, seen from the near left: bottle-green walls, brass picture lamps, red velvet ropes on brass posts and a giant deerstalker hat over the striped puppet booth. At the back left a cheerful lady in a black dress holds up a blue prize rosette behind the iron bars of the old prison-cell exhibit while her friend photographs her; at a café table two old ladies frown comically and tug the one teacup. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret plays the fairy-tale witch in the puppet booth, dipping a red apple into a bubbling green cauldron beside a hobby-horse pony and a girl in a witch hat. At the back right a waxwork gentleman-criminal in a top hat and mask holds an ice lolly and a little bell, and a waxwork villain in a cloak stands empty-handed in a tall glass case with sand at his boots. In front a young woman in a red cape raises a lantern and magnifying glass, a giant striped party popper bursts confetti as a girl in yellow claps, a girl offers a biscuit to a little white dog holding her teddy, and a detective in a deerstalker studies a red jewel cushion smeared with whipped cream. On the right a man in a Hawaiian shirt rushes the gift-shop postcard racks, a grinning masked burglar tiptoes off with a small painting and a fishing rod with a green lure, and a man in a bow tie clutches his hot cheeks beside a flame-red book on a lectern. Doors: slate-blue on the left back to the great hall, iron-studded oak at the back, plain grey at the back right.

armes.name: La salle d'armes · The armoury hall
armes.alt: The museum's armoury hall, seen from the near left: grey stone walls with heraldic banners (one with a smiling golden lion), iron chandeliers and locked glass cases on oak bases; every weapon is an antique object behind glass and nobody holds one. At the back left two lady friends stand arm in arm before a tall case of crossed old weapons; a lady with a guidebook stands by a tall case with a striped jousting lance; a forester lady holds up an ash sprig by the case with an old axe; a shining empty suit of armour stands on a plinth with a ginger cat mewing at its feet. In front a lady offers sweets from a paper bag beside a case with a round black cartoon bomb, its fuse unlit, and a lady hands coins to a guard holding an audio guide by the sword case. In the middle a man in a green cardigan makes a peace sign by the small pistol case, behind him a visitor points at a case of knight's helmets. On the right a guard dozes on a stool by the rifle case, an old gentleman points a yardstick at the jewelled dagger, a man shows a toy Noah's ark by the bow case and a potter holds up a little clay shield beside a big round painted shield. Door: bottle-green on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery.

medecine.name: La galerie de la médecine · The history-of-medicine gallery
medecine.alt: The museum's history-of-medicine gallery, seen from the near left: white and pale teal tiles, honey-wood apothecary cabinets, milk-glass ceiling globes and glass cases. At the back left a scientist peers into a giant brass microscope while her white-haired father in a white coat chats with a friend; a nurse in an old-fashioned cap holds up a giant plain white tube by a sanatorium chair with a tartan blanket; in front a girl in a lab coat sprays a giant green plush germ. In the middle a girl with an ice-cream cone yawns and her two friends yawn too, a farm lady in a headscarf shows an empty wooden bowl beside an empty grain bin of dry wheat stalks, and at the back a girl pours more tea beside a big hourglass whose sand has all run out. In the centre a cheeky long-nosed Pinocchio puppet stands in a glass case, and a cheerful boy on a bench reads a small grey blood-sugar meter beside a bowl of sugar cubes. On the right a Victorian doctor in a top hat and big white collar grips the curved iron pipe of an old black water pump, a boy lifts a giant red blood-cell model over his head, a bearded man in a white coat shows a red crab in a case under a star chart, and a boy walks his collie on a red lead past a case holding an empty old bottle and a glass of water. Doors: slate-blue on the left wall, back to the museum hall; plain grey at the back right, to the health wall-text room.

mots_delits.name: Le couloir des mots (1) · Word corridor 1 (text only)
mots_delits.alt: A quiet, plain word corridor of the museum seen straight down its length: pale grey walls, pale oak floor and three round milk-glass lamps. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights along both walls, five on the left and seven on the right; three low wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A potted fern stands on a bench against the back wall. Doors: plain grey on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery; plain grey at the back, to the next word corridor.

mots_crimes.name: Le couloir des mots (2) · Word corridor 2 (text only)
mots_crimes.alt: The quiet end room of the museum word corridor, wide and square: pale grey walls and a pale oak floor. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights: two on the short left wall, four on the right half of the back wall and six along the right wall; two wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. An arched window lights a bench with a little potted lemon tree on the back wall. Door: plain grey on the left wall, back to the first word corridor.

mots_deuil.alt: The quiet last room of the museum word corridor, softly lit by a round skylight: pale grey walls with a dark-blue skirting board and a pale oak plank floor. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights: two on the left wall, five in a zigzag on the back wall and six along the right wall; two wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque.
